newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Two Bahrainis die in blaze, two injured.
newsitem.headline: Two Bahrainis die in blaze, two injured.

text.p: Two Bahraini nationals died and two others were injured when fire gutted their house in a Bahraini village, a government official said on Thursday.

"Two Bahrainis -- a man and a woman -- died when fire gutted their house in al-Mosalla (village) on Wednesday. Another two people living in the house were also injured from smoke inhalation," the official told Reuters.
"The fire completely destroyed the house," he added, but gave no further details.
It was not immediately clear what had caused the fire in the Shi'ite Moslem village of al-Mosalla, six km (four miles) west of the capital Manama.
Another blaze gutted an Asian workers' residence in the nearby village of al-Daih also on Wednesday, causing damage to the two-storey building but there were no casualties.

The fires were the latest in a series to hit the island, the Gulf's main financial and banking centre. Six Asians were killed in June and July in two separate arson attacks believed related to political unrest that broke out in 1994. Seven Bangladeshi workers died in a blaze in 1996.
